"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { Sign, type SignProps } from "@/components/ui/sign"
import type { SignShape } from "@/lib/0db/sign-shapes"

const shape: SignShape = {
  "word": "tag",
  "line": [
    [
      [
        "M",

        20,

    [

        4,
        15

        "L",
        20,
        15
      ]
    ],
    [
      [
        "M",
        10,
        3
      ],
      [
        "L",
        8,
        21
      ]
    ],
    [
      [
        "M",
        16,
        3
      ],
      [
        "L",
        14,
        21
      ]
    ]
  ]
}

function SignHashDots(props: Omit<SignProps, "shape" | "variant">) {
  return <Sign shape={shape} variant="dots" {...props} />
}

export { SignHashDots, shape }
